shared_elements: standing human-like figure with raised arms
figures arranged on a vertical rectangular field
justification: Both present a tall rectangular field filled with profile animals, a small anthropomorph and a band of repeated tick-like marks, so the generic register-and-silhouette logic is loosely comparable. But A is a sculpted low relief with a few large, stacked, deliberately framed motifs, while B is a flat linear drawing of many small scattered silhouettes dominated by boats, which have no counterpart in A.
